visual.name: bfusionHierarchicalGantt
visual.description: Hierarchical WBS Gantt chart with expand/collapse at every level, zoom slider, year/quarter/month time bands, today marker, milestones, and progress indicators. Built on Vega 5.

dataRoles.name: wbs
dataRoles.description: Hierarchical WBS code. Supports comma- or dot-separated values (e.g. 1,2,3 or 1.2.3).

dataRoles.name: taskorder
dataRoles.description: Optional numeric sort key inside a plan.

dataRoles.name: milestone
dataRoles.description: Boolean flag (true/false) marking the row as a milestone.

dataRoles.name: baselineStart
dataRoles.description: Original planned start date for baseline comparison.

dataRoles.name: baselineEnd
dataRoles.description: Original planned finish date for baseline comparison.

dataRoles.name: taskId
dataRoles.description: Unique task identifier for dependency linking.

dataRoles.name: predecessors
dataRoles.description: Comma-separated predecessor Task IDs. Optionally append :FS, :FF, :SS, or :SF for dependency type.

dataRoles.name: resource
dataRoles.description: Person or resource assigned to the task.

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

timelineFrom.description: Narrow timeline start. Use YYYYMM format (e.g. 202601 = Jan 2026). 0 = auto.

timelineTo.description: Narrow timeline end. Use YYYYMM format (e.g. 202712 = Dec 2027). 0 = auto.

atRiskDelta.description: Status delta cutoff for At Risk. Default -0.15

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.
